description: Drainage element is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Linear location of drainage pipes under the responsibility of the Ministry of Transport and Sustainable Mobility (MTMD). Inventory item of a transverse type or pipe connecting to the ditch, whose diameter is more than 30 cm and less than 3 m.This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate). Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Driving, Dalot, Drain, MTMD, MTQ. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
